# ILLVII Perfumery House

Official website: https://perfumery.kr/
Business: ZEROTONE INC. / 제로톤 주식회사
Brand: ILLVII Perfumery House / 일비 퍼퓨머리 하우스
Location: Seoul, Republic of Korea
Since: 2014

## Services
- Small-batch perfume OEM / ODM
- Minimum order from 50 units depending on specification
- Fragrance development
- Mixing and filling
- Labeling and packaging consultation
- Brand perfume, goods perfume, PB product consultation

## Fragrance development
- 1 fragrance: KRW 200,000
- Includes one sample and one revision
- Production labor, fragrance materials, containers, labels and packaging are quoted separately
